questions.question: Is the assignment effective despite a contractual prohibition (art. 9.1.9)?

branches.summary: Article 9.1.9(1). The assignment of a right to the payment of a monetary sum is effective notwithstanding an agreement limiting or prohibiting such assignment
Article 9.1.9(2). The assignment of a right to other performance contrary to a non-assignment agreement is nevertheless effective if the assignee neither knew nor ought to have known of the agreement

Articles 9.3.1 and 9.3.3. The assignment of a contract is the transfer of the assignor's rights and obligations and requires the consent of the other party

Article 9.1.3. A right to non-monetary performance may be assigned only if the assignment does not render the obligation significantly more burdensome

boundaries.question: Which mandatory rules of the applicable law restrict set-off or assignment?
boundaries.limitation: THIS IS NOT THE LAW OF A STATE. The Principles apply when the parties have agreed on them, or when a court or arbitral tribunal takes them as general principles of law; they do not replace the mandatory rules of the applicable law (article 1.4, hub `unidroit.picc`).

boundaries.question: What does the 1980 UN Convention answer on the assignment of a claim and on set-off?
boundaries.limitation: THE 1980 UN CONVENTION HAS NEITHER SET-OFF NOR ASSIGNMENT NOR SOLIDARITY AT ALL: its subject is the formation of a contract for the international sale of goods and the rights of the parties under it. There is no bridge to `intl.uncitral.cisg*` here in substance, not for want of work; the way to these chapters is opened by article 7(2) of the Convention.

boundaries.question: How are negotiable instruments and obligations transferred on the transfer of a business?
boundaries.limitation: SPECIAL RULES ON NEGOTIABLE INSTRUMENTS AND ON THE TRANSFER OF A BUSINESS ARE EXCLUDED BY THE SOURCE ITSELF (articles 9.1.2, 9.2.2, 9.3.2): their conditions are a question of the applicable law and an input of the case.

boundaries.question: What are the shares of the obligors and the amounts of the obligations in money?
boundaries.limitation: THE MODEL DOES NOT COMPUTE SHARES AND AMOUNTS: articles 8.5, 11.1.9–11.1.13 and 11.2.4 name the rule (to the extent of the lesser obligation, in equal shares, proportionally), while the numbers are brought by the case. Proportional imputation of a set-off (article 8.4(2)) is declared rather than computed for the same reason.

boundaries.question: Is the obligation of an exclusively personal character and does the assignment make it more burdensome?
boundaries.limitation: AN EXCLUSIVELY PERSONAL CHARACTER OF AN OBLIGATION (articles 9.1.7, 9.2.6) AND A SIGNIFICANTLY MORE BURDENSOME OBLIGATION CAUSED BY AN ASSIGNMENT (articles 9.1.3, 9.1.4) ARE FACTS OF THE CASE: both assessments are brought by the case, not derived by the model.

boundaries.question: Which circumstances indicate that the obligations are separate?
boundaries.limitation: SOLIDARITY IS PRESUMED (article 11.1.2), AND THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE REBUT IT. The source does not enumerate which circumstances indicate separate obligations — that is an assertion of the case.
